reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: This is analogous to the history of regression analysis where early practitioners often assumed homoscedastic errors, leading to inefficient estimators. The realization that error variance can differ across observations led to weighted least squares and later generalized linear models. Similarly, in reinforcement learning, the separation of a baseline value function from state-dependent advantage functions decouples the average return from the relative performance, improving stability and convergence.

reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: To avoid anti-collinearity issues, the constant router must be constructed such that its feature space is orthogonal to the information captured by the gate field. If there is significant overlap, the two components will be highly correlated, making it impossible to disentangle their individual contributions.
